fusions.name: Hex-Breaking Disc
fusions.desc: Hurls your shield at the first enemy in its path, dealing 30 damage that ignores resistances.

fusions.name: Clanging Front
fusions.desc: Strikes your shield through a cone 2 tiles ahead, dealing 4 damage to everything in it, with a 30% chance to leave each [Muddled] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Unbending Rampart
fusions.desc: Raises a wall of cold iron 6 tiles long for 8 seconds that blocks enemies and their missiles.

fusions.name: Warding Chill
fusions.desc: 15% of the elemental damage you take is sent back to whoever dealt it. You have 10% arcane resistance.
